title: SOC2 daily scratchpad - vendor reviews & evidence TODO
content:
Daily scratchpad - SOC2 evidence / vendor reviews / policy TODOs

Notes to self (rough):
- Morning: sync w/ Evelyn 10:30 - go over outstanding evidence packets for CC6, CC7.
- Need to chase infra for logs export config (ticket SEC-112). Confirm retention policy matches control matrix.

Top priorities (this week):
- [ ] Finalize evidence bundle for user access review (CC6) - collect: access_logs-2025-10 (S3 path?), iam-change-history export, admin-approval emails. TODO: ask SRE to provide export job schedule.
- [ ] Vendor risk review: HashSec (vendor) - confirm SOC2/ISO certs, review subservice org mapping. Create summary for procurement. (JIRA-345)
- [ ] Update policy draft: "Temporary Credentials" - clarify 1-hour max for service accounts; attach exception process. Put draft on Confluence and link in PR.
- [ ] Complete evidence snapshot for change management process (CC3) need PR list for last 12 months and approvals. Link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/789 (filter by labels: change-mgmt).

Vendor review notes (quick):
- HashSec: claims ISO27001 but no public cert; vendor portal shows 2019 audit. Need point of contact (POC) and current attestation. Ask procurement to request updated cert + SOC2 Type II.
- CloudDB vendor: completed questionnaire; open items: encryption-at-rest KMS details, key rotation cadence. Follow-up w/ infra@ by EOD Thu.

Evidence collection checklist (practical):
- Access control
  - [ ] Admin user list export (IAM) - obtain from infra (Liam)
  - [ ] MFA enforcement screenshot + policy page (console)
- Change management
  - [ ] PR approvals for prod deploys (last 12 months) - script to export PR metadata
  - [ ] Change request tickets with approvals (search JIRA: label change-request)
- Logging & monitoring
  - [ ] Log export config (SEC-112)
  - [ ] Alerting runbook snapshot (SRE handbook page)

Meetings / reminders:
- 2025-11-05 14:00 \u2014 call w/ procurement + legal: vendor contract clause for audit rights. Prep: vendor list + current attestation status.
- 2025-11-06 09:00 \u2014 design review: proposed log retention increase (30 -> 90 days) - impact on S3 costs; Need cost estimate.

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- Where do we store evidence bundles for audit review? Current suggestion: private Confluence page + mirrored to secure S3 bucket with limited ACLs. Confirm with legal.
- Who signs off on exceptions for temporary credentials? Add to policy draft: exceptions -> engineering lead + security lead.
- Can we automate vendor cert checks? Look into cert-monitoring tool options (third-party).

Quick drafts / copy for Confluence (scratch):
Title: "Evidence bundle - CC6: Logical Access"
Summary: bundle contains admin list, IAM changes, MFA enforcement logs, sampled access reviews. Please attach the following artifacts: IAM_export_2025-10.csv, mfa_policy_screenshot.png, access_review_2025-09.pdf

Slack refs / links to follow up:
- #sec-team thread: "vendor-hashsec" (ask procurement for POC)
- #infra-alerts: log export job id (once created)

If time:
- Start small script to pull PR approvals (python + gh api) and store CSV. Use creds from service account; ensure token has least privilege.

Misc scribbles:
- audit timeline target: have bundles ready by 2025-12-01 for SOC2 pre-audit review.
- think about tagging evidence artifacts with control ids for easier lookup.

End of scratchpad.
